name: oMega Obby 🌟 725 Stages!
desc:
🔥 Take on 727 stages in oMega Obby! 🌈

🏁 Reach checkpoints, earn Coins, unlock cosmetics, and keep climbing!

- 🪙 Earn Coins by completing stages
- 🌈 Unlock Trails, Auras & Completion Effects
- 🔄 Prestige and keep pushing your progress
- 🧪 Use Mutators to play small, upside-down, or backwards
- 👍 Leave a like and ⭐ favorite!

Tags: Obby, Parkour, Mega Fun, Easy, Rainbow, Mega Obby
